drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a revised draft for discussion. To facilitate a prompt resolution, it includes a proposed settlement amount and clarifies payment timing, the scope of the release, and customary limits on confidentiality. Please let us know your client’s comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. In consideration of the releases and other promises in this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 30,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. Payment shall be made within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. The parties shall reasonably cooperate to complete the payment promptly.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff, for itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, and representatives, releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement, through the Effective Date. This release does not apply to claims to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the existence and terms of this Agreement confidential and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, financing sources, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations, or as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process. A party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this section restricts disclosures necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment of the Settlement Amount are a compromise of disputed claims and are not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim by either party.
edits.name: No Admission

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff, for itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, and representatives, releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the specifically identified dispute resolved by this Agreement, through the Effective Date. This release does not apply to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the existence and terms of this Agreement confidential and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, financing sources, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations; to tax authorities; as reasonably necessary for ordinary business, tax, or compliance purposes; or as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process. A party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this section restricts disclosures necessary to enforce this Agreement.
